product_summary: Website (bnazrum.com, homepage and /products/ page) presents the company as a grower-processor-exporter of fresh and provisionally preserved vegetables from Dindigul, Tamil Nadu: gherkins (core product, 'Gherkin Exporter in India' in the site title), baby corn / sweet corn, silver-skin onions, bell pepper, green chilli, jalapenos, paprika, banana, cherry tomatoes, mixed vegetables, ladies' finger (okra), eggplant, cauliflower, beetroot. Site also claims pickled/cured gherkin production ('Crafting the Finest Pickled Delights'), own farms plus contract farmers, and certifications FSSAI, APEDA, IFS International, Kosher, FDA. Declared client list on the site: Unilever Europe, Reitzel France, Richard Konar Belgium, WFTS Russia, MJ Rosen Mayer USA, IFG Germany, Rafael Spain, Hanmi South Korea, Whunche Germany, Triple-O-Plodo Russia, plus retail/agent names (Albert Heijn, Maxima, Globus, Lorado, Vitaland, Lutik, Dyadya Vanya). All of the above is website self-declaration only - no customs line, B/L or invoice was reviewed in this task, so every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - site claims own farms/fields plus sourcing from independent farmers and in-house processing/packing ('Original Product Manufacturer', 'we oversee both our own farms and those cultivated by independent farmers'), i.e. a hybrid grower-processor that also aggregates third-party produce for export. No registry evidence checked in this task (out of scope).
comment: HS 071140 is CORRECT but NARROW: it covers only cucumbers/gherkins provisionally preserved (in brine/sulphur dioxide), which is indeed the company's flagship line and matches the site's self-description as a gherkin exporter. However the declared single 6-digit code covers only a fraction of the stated product range. Missing from the declaration: fresh/chilled vegetables (0702, 0703, 0704, 0707, 0709), bananas (0803), black pepper (0904), and - if the 'pickled delights' line is shipped as a finished vinegar-preserved product rather than brine stock - 200110. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification for the bulk of the range: this is primarily a FRESH PRODUCE / agro-commodity exporter (HS 07/08), not an FMCG/processed-food company; only the pickled-gherkin line would sit in prepared-food territory (HS 20). Trader signs: the site simultaneously claims to be the manufacturer/grower AND lists a long roster of third-party buyers/agents and 'independent farmers who supply produce to the Company', which is consistent with an aggregator-exporter model rather than a pure own-farm producer - role should be treated as manufacturer_trader, not pure manufacturer. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained and the code set is corrected/expanded to the actual range above; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Verification status: all product claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, B/L, GST turnover or contract was examined here, so no shipment factuality is asserted either way. Note also that the site's 'Clients Feedback' block contains obvious placeholder lorem-ipsum testimonials ('Sit amet consectetu escing elit...') and the blog section carries unrelated US pickle-brand news (Wickles Pickles acquisition) - a sign of a template site, which further weakens the evidentiary value of the client list. Revenue and export volumes: null (not researched in this task, out of scope).
